title: School Calendar Fragmentation Dataset
description: One row per district, one school year. Phase 1 covers 2025-2026.

rank.description: Enrollment rank among US districts (1 = largest). Source: NCES CCD most recent available year.

district_name.description: Official district name as published by NCES.

district_id.description: Prefixed district identifier. Format: '{source}:{id}'. Supported prefixes: 'nces:' (NCES CCD LEA ID for US public districts), 'pss:' (NCES Private School Survey ID for private schools), 'manual:' (hand-assigned ID for districts/schools not in either federal source). Designed for forward-compatibility across public, private, charter, and international calendars.

enrollment.description: Total student enrollment, most recent NCES year available at time of extraction.

school_year.description: Academic year the calendar covers, e.g., '2025-2026'.

calendar_source_url.description: Direct URL to the official calendar document as published by the district.

first_day_of_school.description: First instructional day for students, ISO 8601.

last_day_of_school.description: Last instructional day for students, ISO 8601.

total_weekdays_in_school_year.description: Count of Monday-Friday weekdays between first_day_of_school and last_day_of_school, inclusive.

total_calendar_weeks.description: Count of Mon-Fri blocks between first and last instructional day. Partial start/end weeks are excluded.

total_instructional_days.description: Count of days students are scheduled to attend for full-day instruction. Excludes holidays, breaks, teacher-only days, and early release days.

unbroken_five_day_weeks.description: PRIMARY METRIC. Count of Mon-Fri blocks in which all five weekdays are full instructional days — no holidays, half-days, early dismissals, teacher workdays, or modified schedules.

percent_weeks_unbroken.description: unbroken_five_day_weeks / total_calendar_weeks, as a percentage rounded to 1 decimal place.

longest_unbroken_streak.description: Longest consecutive run of unbroken five-day weeks.

early_release_day_count.description: Days where students attend but are dismissed early. Includes 'minimum days,' 'early dismissal,' half-days (when students are present for part of the day), and parent-teacher conference shortened days.

teacher_only_day_count.description: Days where students do not attend but staff do: professional development days, in-service days, institute days, clerical days, teacher workdays.

holiday_day_count.description: Federal, state, local, and religious holidays observed as full school closures.

break_day_count.description: Full days off for multi-day breaks (Thanksgiving week, winter break, spring break, mid-winter break).

total_non_instructional_days.description: Sum of holiday_day_count + break_day_count + teacher_only_day_count + early_release_day_count (where early release is counted as a fractional day lost; see methodology.md).

has_multiple_calendars.description: True if district runs separate calendars for different grade bands (e.g., elementary vs. high school with different early-dismissal schedules). If true, this row reflects the dominant/most-common calendar; see per-district dossier for details.

extracted_at.description: Date the calendar was parsed, ISO 8601.

human_verified.description: Whether a human has reviewed the LLM extraction against the source calendar.

notes.description: Free-text field for unusual patterns, judgment calls, or caveats specific to this row.
